mapper.sql: COALESCE( NULLIF(( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(tt.type_name ORDER BY rel.is_primary DESC, rel.sort_order ASC, rel.id ASC SEPARATOR ' / ') FROM app_movie_type_rel rel INNER JOIN app_movie_type tt ON tt.id = rel.type_id WHERE rel.movie_id = m.id ), ''), t.type_name, m.legacy_type_name )
COALESCE(( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(mm.media_url ORDER BY mm.sort_order SEPARATOR ',') FROM app_movie_media mm WHERE mm.movie_id = m.id AND mm.media_role = 'poster' ), m.poster_urls_csv)

COALESCE( NULLIF(( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(p.person_name ORDER BY rel.sort_order ASC, rel.id ASC SEPARATOR ' / ') FROM app_movie_person_rel rel INNER JOIN app_movie_person p ON p.id = rel.person_id WHERE rel.movie_id = m.id AND rel.relation_type = 'director' ), ''), m.director_name )

COALESCE( NULLIF(( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(p.person_name ORDER BY rel.sort_order ASC, rel.id ASC SEPARATOR ' / ') FROM app_movie_person_rel rel INNER JOIN app_movie_person p ON p.id = rel.person_id WHERE rel.movie_id = m.id AND rel.relation_type = 'cast' ), ''), m.cast_names )
COALESCE( m.movie_type_id, ( SELECT rel.type_id FROM app_movie_type_rel rel WHERE rel.movie_id = m.id ORDER BY rel.is_primary DESC, rel.sort_order ASC, rel.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) )
LEFT JOIN app_movie_type t ON t.id = m.movie_type_id LEFT JOIN app_movie_region r ON r.id = m.region_id

m.id AS id, m.title AS title, AS typeName, AS posterUrlsCsv, AS regionName, m.release_date AS releaseDate, AS directorName, AS castNames, m.synopsis AS synopsis, m.like_count AS likeCount, m.dislike_count AS dislikeCount, m.click_count AS clickCount, m.comment_count AS commentCount, m.favorite_count AS favoriteCount, m.total_score AS totalScore

where.if: AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM app_movie_type_rel filterRel INNER JOIN app_movie_type filterType ON filterType.id = filterRel.type_id WHERE filterRel.movie_id = m.id AND filterType.type_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.typeName}, '%') ) OR t.type_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.typeName}, '%') OR m.legacy_type_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.typeName}, '%') )

mapper.select: SELECT id AS id, type_name AS typeName FROM app_movie_type ORDER BY type_name ASC

SELECT a.legacy_userid AS legacyUserId, a.movie_id AS movieId, MAX( CASE WHEN a.action_type = 'favorite' THEN 1.0 WHEN a.action_type = 'like' THEN 0.8 ELSE 0 END ) AS preferenceScore FROM app_user_movie_action a WHERE a.legacy_userid IS NOT NULL AND a.movie_id IS NOT NULL AND a.action_type IN ('favorite', 'like') GROUP BY a.legacy_userid, a.movie_id

SELECT , m.legacy_dianyingxinxi_id AS legacyDianyingxinxiId, m.created_at AS createdAt, m.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM app_movie m
ORDER BY ${params.sortColumn} ${params.orderKeyword} LIMIT #{params.offset}, #{params.limit}

SELECT m.id AS id, m.legacy_dianyingxinxi_id AS legacyDianyingxinxiId, AS typeId, m.title AS title, AS typeName, AS posterUrlsCsv, AS regionName, m.release_date AS releaseDate, AS directorName, AS castNames, m.synopsis AS synopsis, m.detail_html AS detailHtml, m.like_count AS likeCount, m.dislike_count AS dislikeCount, m.click_count AS clickCount, m.comment_count AS commentCount, m.favorite_count AS favoriteCount, m.total_score AS totalScore FROM app_movie m
WHERE m.id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM app_movie) AS movieTotal, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(click_count), 0) FROM app_movie) AS totalClickCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM app_user_movie_action WHERE action_type = 'like') AS totalLikeCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM app_user_movie_action WHERE action_type = 'dislike') AS totalDislikeCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM app_user_movie_action WHERE action_type = 'favorite') AS totalFavoriteCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM app_movie_comment) AS totalCommentCount, (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(total_score), 1), 0) FROM app_movie) AS totalScore

SELECT typed.label AS label, COUNT(1) AS value, COALESCE(SUM(typed.clickCount), 0) AS extraValue FROM ( SELECT rel.movie_id AS movieId, tt.type_name AS label, m.click_count AS clickCount FROM app_movie_type_rel rel INNER JOIN app_movie_type tt ON tt.id = rel.type_id INNER JOIN app_movie m ON m.id = rel.movie_id UNION ALL SELECT m.id AS movieId, COALESCE(t.type_name, m.legacy_type_name, '未分类') AS label, m.click_count AS clickCount FROM app_movie m LEFT JOIN app_movie_type t ON t.id = m.movie_type_id WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM app_movie_type_rel rel WHERE rel.movie_id = m.id ) ) typed GROUP BY typed.label ORDER BY value DESC, label ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COALESCE(DATE_FORMAT(m.release_date, '%Y'), '未知') AS label, COUNT(1) AS value, COALESCE(SUM(m.click_count), 0) AS extraValue FROM app_movie m GROUP BY COALESCE(DATE_FORMAT(m.release_date, '%Y'), '未知') ORDER BY label DESC LIMIT #{limit}
